title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Enterprise Architect , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo .

In this role you will:

The Enterprise Architect will be centrally responsible for the strategic definition and implementation of Canada's enterprise architecture, working from the design and governance of systems to the integration of technological platforms and operational mining processes. Its mission is to translate business objectives into modern, secure and scalable architectures, aligned with international standards and the automation, sustainability and innovation goals of the group.

This professional will work in partnership with the global Enterprise Architect and cross-functional areas (IT, Operations, Engineering, ESG), ensuring that each solution offers efficient integration between on-premises, cloud, and industrial automation environments. He will have a profound influence on technology decisions, playing an advisory role with Canadian and Brazilian leadership, promoting a collaborative, innovative and results-oriented environment.

To succeed, you must demonstrate strategic vision, technical leadership, exceptional intercultural communication skills, and mastery of regulatory requirements in both Canada and Brazil.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve integrated Enterprise Architecture models (business, applications, data, technology), using frameworks such as TOGAF/ArchiMate and aligning with the strategic demands of mining, sustainability and digital transformation.
  • Act as a technical reference, leading cross-functional teams, promoting the consolidation of solutions between IT, OT and industrial automation, ensuring adherence to global corporate standards.
  • Evaluate and validate new technologies, platforms, services and methods (Cloud, Edge Computing, Digital Twins, IoT, Analytics, Cybersecurity), always considering the best practices in the mineral and natural resources sector.
  • Develop and maintain architectural criteria that prioritize security, regulatory compliance (LGPD, PIPEDA, GDPR), performance, sustainability and operational integration between Canada and Brazil.
  • Prepare detailed documentation (LLD/HLD, reference architectures, guidelines), transferring knowledge and mentoring technical and business teams both locally and internationally.
  • Lead communication between technical, operations, engineering, and global leaders, promoting efficient collaboration and respecting cultural differences.
  • Continuously analyze technological, regulatory and business trends, proposing standards and improvements that position as an international reference in sustainable and digital mining.
  • Participate directly in the supplier selection/merger processes, prioritizing interoperability, innovation and return on investment in critical projects.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Proven experience (minimum of 8 years in IT, with at least 5 as an enterprise architect or similar strategic role in Large Enterprise or mining/resources).
  • Deep knowledge of the mineral, energy or industrial sector, preferably previous experience in large global operations (e.g., Petrobras, Rio Tinto, Barrick Gold, Anglo American).
  • Mastery of the main enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF: Practitioner, ArchiMate, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Excellence in the use of cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) and data platforms, cross-system integration (ERP SAP/Oracle, SCADA, IIoT, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
  • Ability to design hybrid architectures (on-premises, cloud, edge), industrial data integration (sensing, automation, dashboards, analytics).
  • Strong performance in compliance, industrial cybersecurity (OT/IT Convergence), data protection, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Experience in multinational/cross-border projects, especially Brazil-Canada.
  • Fluent English (technical communication, executive meetings, documentation), advanced Portuguese is a strategic differential for integration between teams.

Soft Skills

  • Advanced communication skills, capable of transmitting complex technical concepts to different audiences (executives, engineers, IT, business).
  • Global strategic vision, aligning local and global initiatives with corporate objectives in sustainable mining, innovation and automation.
  • Analytical and solution-oriented thinking, with high ability to navigate complex, multifunctional and multicultural environments.
  • Collaborative leadership – mentoring, consensus building, influence without direct authority, and excellent internal/external networking skills.
  • Management of priorities, organization and resilience in the face of multiple parallel projects and ad-hoc demands.
  • Absolute focus on results, delivering tangible value for operation, innovation and sustainability.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • TOGAF (Expert) certification, AWS/Azure/GCP Solution Architect, CISA, PMP/Agile, specializations in ESG, digital mining, cyber OT/IT.
  • Hands-on experience with emerging platforms: Digital Twins, AI/ML/Ops, real-time streaming (Kafka, Spark Streaming, Flink), infrastructures as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Experience in due diligence processes, merger & acquisition, integration of multi-company systems.
  • Active participation in architecture forums, mining, global events, technical publications or international presentations.
  • Background with SAP, Oracle, SIEMENS, Rockwell, GE Predix, Azure IoT/Edge/Analytics solutions, sustainability frameworks and ESG reporting.

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Align the needs of global business, Canada and Brazil with the vision of enterprise architecture and technological roadmap.
  • Ensure that all solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, performance, regulatory compliance and operational excellence.
  • To be an agent of transformation and innovation, proposing disruptive solutions to digital and operational challenges in the mining sector.
  • Mentor and develop technical capacity of the teams, promoting architecture culture, documentation and standardization.
  • Lead the preparation and presentation of business cases, technical justifications and architectural alternatives to senior executives and regional and global boards.
  • Organize, sustain and evolve architecture governance, support strategic decisions and ensure the permanent alignment of solutions with business objectives and international compliance.

Additional Comments:

This is a key role in Canada's technological and cultural transformation, requiring active action in multicultural environments, with flexibility for travel, meetings in different time zones and continuous adaptation to trends in the mining sector and global architecture. The presence of fluent English is mandatory, while mastery of Portuguese enhances Brazil-Canada integration, directly impacting the success of the project. Technical certifications, previous experience in operations, participation in modernization/digitalization initiatives and innovative mindset will be major differentials in the selection process.

• Gestão de Contas-Chave: Atendimento e desenvolvimento de grandes redes varejistas.

• Negociação Estratégica: Fechar acordos de sell-in e sell-out, negociar tablóides e garantir a melhor exposição dos produtos.

• Formação Superior (completa ou em andamento) Administração, Marketing, em áreas correlatas.

• Habilidades essenciais: Foco em Resultados, Disciplina, Relacionamento Interpessoal e Competência Técnica em Negociação.

Benefícios:

Convênio médico e odontológico;

title: Country Leader, Programs (Brazil)
description:
The Senior Advisor is the primary responsible executive for the success of the Alliance to End Plastic Waste (AEPW) program in-country. This role is accountable for delivering the full scope of the country program in alignment with AEPW Strategy 2030, ensuring that projects are designed and executed as part of a system-change agenda rather than isolated interventions. The Senior Advisor manages all in-country stakeholders—including government entities, DFIs, industry partners, and implementing organizations—and oversees AEPW staff, consultants, and contractors to ensure programs are delivered safely, efficiently, compliantly, and with measurable impact.

The Senior Advisor is both a strategic representative of AEPW to external stakeholders and an operational manager ensuring contract compliance, impact reporting, and staff performance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Program Strategy & Alignment

  • Develop, maintain, and execute a comprehensive country strategy aligned with AEPW’s global Strategy 2030.
  • Ensure that 80–90% of projects drive system-level transformation (e.g., integrated waste infrastructure, EPR alignment, circular economy enablers) with the remaining 10–20% focused on pilots for learning, impact generation, or stakeholder engagement.
  • Identify opportunities for replication and scaling across the country and region.
  • Anticipate regulatory, political, and market shifts that may affect the program; adapt strategy proactively

2. Stakeholder Engagement & Representation

  • Work very closely with AEPW Members, and facilitate all PAG, pre-PAG, and Member engagement relative to the Country Program Implementation.
  • Serve as AEPW’s senior representative in-country, maintaining strong relationships with: a) Local and national government ministries, regulators, and municipalities; b) DFIs and co-funding partners active in waste and circular economy infrastructure; c) Industry stakeholders including brands, recyclers, and waste operators; and d) Civil society groups, NGOs, and academic institutions.
  • Represent AEPW in policy dialogues, conferences, and industry roundtables, ensuring the organization is seen as a co-creator of solutions.
  • Work with the Central PA team to ensure alignment of government relations.
  • Act as primary escalation point for all stakeholder issues arising within the program.

3. Project Development & Execution Oversight

  • Guide development of new projects to ensure alignment with program objectives and system-change principles.
  • Review and approve project proposals prior to submission to the Portfolio Management Committee / Governing Council.
  • Oversee in-country execution teams and implementing partners to ensure adherence to AEPW’s global standards.
  • Ensure strict compliance with AEPW’s E2E Program Implementation process, safeguard requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Conduct regular site visits, milestone reviews, and partner performance evaluations.
  • Collaborate with Circular Solutions Centre to ensure technical due diligence and innovation pilots are rigorously assessed.

4. Contract Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all projects adhere to the terms of their contracts, including milestones, disbursement conditions, reporting obligations, and safeguard actions.
  • Work closely with Central Legal / Contracts to enforce compliance and resolve disputes.
  • Maintain a country-level risk register and escalate risks (financial, operational, reputational, HSE) to the Central Risk team.
  • Ensure world-class HSE standards are embedded in all project activities, in line with AEPW expectations and international best practices.

5. Financial Structuring & Oversight

  • Collaborate with Impact Finance to co-structure deals with DFIs, private investors, and corporate co-funders.
  • Monitor financial performance of all projects (grants, loans, blended finance) including repayment obligations.
  • Ensure transparent and timely financial reporting for donors, DFIs, and AEPW central finance.

6. Impact Measurement & Reporting

  • Ensure all projects deliver on AEPW’s impact metrics: plastic waste collected, sorted, and valorized; access to waste management; jobs created; safety performance, etc..
  • Work with Global Support to provide accurate and timely reporting for impact metrics, Portfolio Management Committee / Governing council, donor, and member communications.
  • Facilitate external audits, evaluations, and lessons-learned reviews.

7. People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and manage all AEPW employees and consultants in-country.
  • Ensure teams operate safely, efficiently, and productively with clear accountability.
  • Foster a culture of compliance, transparency, and impact delivery.
  • Build local capacity by coaching and developing staff and ensuring knowledge transfer across teams.
  • Ensure strong collaboration across functions (Execution, CSC, Support, Finance, Legal, PA and Strategy/Planning).

Requirements / Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in business, engineering, public policy, or a related field.
  • Minimum 20+ years’ experience in senior leadership roles within infrastructure, development, or circular economy sectors.
  • Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with government, DFIs, corporates, and NGOs.
  • Strong contract management, compliance, and risk oversight skills.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen in structuring and monitoring large-scale projects.
  • Experience working in international development, public-private partnerships, or donor-funded projects highly preferred.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and diplomatic skills.
  • High integrity, resilience under pressure, and ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on operational management.

title: Government Relations Director, Brazil
description:
SHEIN

Founded in 2012, SHEIN is a leading global online retailer, with operations in Guangzhou,

Singapore, Los Angeles, and other key markets around the world. SHEIN reaches consumers

in more than 150 locations globally, enabling them to access more fashion, beauty and

lifestyle products easily and conveniently, at affordable prices. Our mission is to help

everyone - regardless of their location, body size, ethnicity, income level - express their

individuality through access to the latest trends.

SHEIN works with outstanding, creative and highly capable peers. Our culture is energetic,

collaborative and open to new ideas and suggestions, enabling outstanding individuals to

come together and ignite new possibilities as a team. SHEIN welcomes passionate and

enthusiastic individuals to join us in driving SHEIN’s growth and expansion globally, making

it possible for everyone to wear and live their most wonderful lives.

Summary of Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the analysis and providing

assessment of relevant public policy issues and their implications on SHEIN’s business

interests in Brazil. He/she is responsible for fostering strategic partnerships with key

stakeholders and translating policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to

advance SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil. He/she will also plan,

organise and manage SHEIN’s various stakeholder engagement platforms in Brazil, in

support of the objective to expand and enhance our collaborations with key stakeholders from various backgrounds such as political/regulatory stakeholders, civil society, industry

associations and other public arenas.

In this role, the candidate must be able to work effectively with various teams, including the Customer Service, Sustainability, Legal, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams, to advance

SHEIN’s corporate interests in Brazil. He/she should possess a deep interest and ability to

understand how politics, business, fashion, sustainability, technology and innovation, as well as international relations are interconnected.

Job Responsibilities

  • Track, monitor and assess strategic/policy issues and their implications to SHEIN’s commercial interests in Brazil.
  • Develop and provide recommendations to SHEIN’s senior management and relevant business units concerning political, policy, and regulatory issues.
  • Identify, engage and build relations with key stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, non-governmental organizations, media, and industry associations) to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil.
  • Identify and map key policy stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, international organisations, non-governmental organisations and industry associations).
  • Develop and drive engagement strategies to reach out and build strategic relationships with key stakeholders to strengthen SHEIN’s network of partners.
  • Formulate and execute advocacy plans to translate policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts.
  • Develop and drive strategic communications plans and partnerships in support of company’s overall policy positioning and profiling.
  • Organise and manage meetings with external parties, including the preparation of briefing notes/presentations for senior management’s reference.
  • Lead in the planning, organisation and management of networking platforms

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Degree in International Relations, Political Science, Global Studies, Law, Economics, Communications, Media, Journalism, or related fields.
  • At least 10 years of working experience in corporate/public affairs, and/or government relations/public policy, and/or corporate communications/public relations.
  • Experience in policy research, development, and analysis, and/or track record in developing and implementing external communication strategies/campaigns
  • Strong policy/regulatory network and/or media relations in Brazil.
  • Strong analytical, presentation (written and oral), and project management skills.
  • Good knowledge and experience in digital media tools/platforms
  • Strong proficiency in English and Portuguese; Spanish preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and have exceptional attention to detail while operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

description:
DEIXE-NOS DIZER O QUE NOS TORNA GENUÍNOS…

Procuramos profissionais que queiram se reinventar a cada dia, que queiram enfrentar desafios em seu DNA e que sejam apaixonados por trabalhar com tecnologia/cibersegurança. Isso nos torna únicos e autênticos.

O que buscamos?

Procuramos um profissional Arquiteto SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) SR , para compor nosso time.

O que vai fazer?

  • Criar arquiteturas escaláveis e altamente disponíveis, considerando tolerância a falhas, balanceamento de carga e redundância.
  • Adotar práticas de chaos engineering para validar a resiliência da infraestrutura.
  • Atuar com automação e infraestrutura como Código (IaC)
  • Definir padrões de automação para provisionamento, configuração e gerenciamento de infraestrutura.

  • Projetar estratégias de monitoramento proativo usando Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack e outras ferramentas.
  • Criar SLOs (Service Level Objectives), SLIs (Service Level Indicators) e SLAs (Service Level Agreements) para medir a confiabilidade do sistema.
  • Criar processos para resolução rápida de incidentes e resposta a falhas.
  • Desenvolver playbooks e runbooks para automação da resposta a incidentes.
  • Trabalhar na eficiência de uso de recursos, evitando desperdícios na nuvem e melhorando o desempenho dos serviços.
  • Implementar práticas de FinOps para otimizar custos de infraestrutura.
  • Fomentar práticas de CI/CD e integração contínua com pipelines automatizados.
  • Definir processos para rollback seguro, feature flags e testes em produção.

O que é necessário?

  • Experiência como SRE, com ampla vivência em ferramentas de observabilidade, principalmente o Dynatrace;
  • Conhecimento em Práticas de FinOps com foco em otimização de custos e previsões de produtos;
  • Atuação com indicadores Golden Signals ou Page Status;
  • Habituado em responder a incidentes críticos e propor ações preventivas para evitar recorrência (Postmortem / RCA);
  • Atuação anterior como DevOps ou funções similares;
  • Conhecimento em ambiente de Cloud (AWS);
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de programação e similares, como DQL (Data Query Language) que é subconjunto da SQL (Structured Query Language).
  • Formação: Superior em tecnologia ou áreas relacionadas.

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Contract CRA Project - 40 hours per week 1 year contract.

Seizure or Epilepsy - CNS

Job Summary:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to monitor and manage Phase 2 Seizure study clinical trials. The CRA will ensure the trial is conducted in compliance with regulatory standards, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and the study protocol. This position involves collaborating with investigators, site personnel, and cross-functional teams to ensure the safety and well-being of participants in early-phase clinical trials.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Site Management and Monitoring:
  • Conduct site qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, and close-out visits.
  • Ensure proper site adherence to protocols, GCP, and regulatory requirements.
  • Verify and ensure accurate data collection and reporting.
  • Assess site performance and provide corrective actions if necessary.
  • Regulatory Compliance:
  • Ensure all clinical trial documentation is maintained according to regulatory guidelines.
  • Review informed consent documents and confirm proper consenting procedures.
  • Collaborate with regulatory teams to ensure timely submissions and approvals.
  • Safety and Data Management:
  • Monitor and report adverse events (AEs), serious adverse events (SAEs), and dose-limiting toxicities.
  • Validate source data and resolve data discrepancies.
  • Ensure timely and accurate documentation of clinical trial data in electronic data capture (EDC) systems.
  • Collaboration and Communication:
  • Build and maintain relationships with study investigators and site staff.
  • Communicate study updates and findings to study sponsors and internal teams.
  • Provide training to site personnel on study protocols, procedures, and GCP compliance.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences , Nursing , or a related field.
  • At least 2-4 years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate in oncology trials, with preference for Phase 2 experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) , FDA regulations, and ICH guidelines.
  • Experience with electronic data capture (EDC) systems and clinical trial management systems (CTMS).
  • Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in early-phase oncology trials (e.g., dose escalation studies, first-in-human trials).
  • Strong understanding of pharmacokinetics (PK) and pharmacodynamics (PD) assessments.
  • Certification as a Clinical Research Professional (CCRA) is a plus.

title: Químico (a) laboratório pesquisa e desenvolvimento
description:

title: GERENTE DE MIX E VAREJO
description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 14 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 3 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.

⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO

Fortalecer a área como um pilar estratégico dentro do Grupo Iguatemi, consolidando sua posição como uma das referências formais em inovação.

Garantir o NOI dos shoppings e o EBITDA corporativo por meio de uma curadoria assertiva de lojas e marcas para todos os malls e para o Iguatemi 365, orientando as decisões a partir dos quatro pilares da área: inteligência, inovação, planejamento e relacionamento.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

Fazer o planejamento anual dos shoppings para definição das prioridades estratégicas (principais oportunidades e desafios), diagnóstico do mix ideal de lojas, mapeamento de marcas (considerando posicionamento, faixa etária e estilo) e vocação, sempre alinhadas com as principais tendências globais e que possuem sinergia com o nosso negócio;

Desenvolver operações exclusivas para os shoppings do grupo e garantir o diferencial e melhor experiência para o consumidor, além da integridade dos corredores estratégicos, áreas que definem a identidade e posicionamento de cada shopping representando parte dos atributos que compõem e reforçam a marca Iguatemi;

Desenvolver estudos de grupos econômicos para analisar presença geográfica das marcas, verificar oportunidades em nossos malls, possíveis parcerias com outros empreendedores, infrações cometidas, além de mapear pleitos e concessões;

Desenvolvimento de agenda estratégica de grupos econômicos com o objetivo de formar negociações e repassar decisões para equipe comercial elaborar propostas. Além disso, a gerência é responsável por definir também as estratégicas de expansão dos lojistas considerando as informações do acompanhamento da performance de vendas e visitas mensais à concorrência.

Garantir o atingimento do NOI / receita dos seus shoppings através da efetividade das iniciativas propostas no PIX e desdobradas no 5YP e 3YP com trocas de lojas efetivas (sales spread positivo), participação ativa no orçamento anual dos shoppings, curva de entrada e saída de lojas, definição de allowance e expectativa de vendas.

Garantir o atingimento trimestral em ABL por shopping projetado no pipeline de assinaturas e acompanhar a taxa de ocupação divulgada para o mercado, além de fazer a gestão do plano de ação para locação das áreas por meio de contrato de leasing/mídia semanalmente em recop e garantir a abertura da operação para que não ocorra impacto negativo na receita líquida.

Analisar as pesquisas por categoria do share (faturamento) que cada um dos shoppings ocupa em relação aos seus concorrentes diretos, oportunidade de crescimento do ticket médio e perfil dos clientes por renda, para a melhor tomada de decisão na estratégia de fortalecimento das categorias com marcas fortes que seja atrativo para o cliente alvo.

Avaliar a exposição em ABL, receita e vendas para marcas internacionais nos shoppings únicos (Iguatemi São Paulo, JK e Brasília) e garantir o melhor equilibrio nos contratos comerciais.

Definir vocação, mix ideal e planejar as lojas por categoria e segmento dos greenfields e expansões, além de elaborar junto com a arquitetura e engenharia as plantas e acompanhar / comercializar as lojas junto com a área comercial.

Realizar reuniões frequentes (aquecimento de lead) com lojistas para garantir gestão do portfólio e melhores negociações comerciais (leasing spread positivo, coparticipação, exclusividade, etc).

Realizar a curadoria de marcas para o Iguatemi 365 e garantir equilíbrio no mix de produtos dentro de suas categorias.

OBSERVAÇÕES

Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Marketing, Moda, Comunicação, Engenharia, Design.

Pós Graduação em Marketing, Moda, Varejo (diferencial)

title: Analista de Dados II
description:
MUITO MAIS QUE UMA STARTUP ⚡

  • Realizar análises de dados, identificando padrões e gerando insights que apoiem as áreas de negócio, com escopo moderado e complexidade intermediária.

  • Buscar entendimento das regras de negócio e necessidades dos stakeholders, participando do planejamento e da definição de métricas e KPIs.
  • Auxiliar na documentação de processos, regras de cálculo e estruturas de dados, seguindo diretrizes de segurança da informação e LGPD.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Para essa posição, esperamos que você tenha:

  • SQL intermediário a avançado (preferencialmente em BigQuery, mas experiência em outros bancos é aceita).
  • Ferramentas de BI: Power BI, Metabase, Data Studio ou Looker.
  • Noções de cloud computing (preferencialmente GCP; experiência com AWS ou Azure é um diferencial).
  • Capacidade de estruturar análises e apresentar resultados com clareza (storytelling com dados).
  • Conhecimentos básicos em processos de ETL/ELT e boas práticas de governança de dados.

description:
Product Owner, PO Técnico ou Analista de Negócios Sênior

INGLES FLUENTE

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em plataformas de crédito ou antifraude.
  • Experiência na definição de KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) para monitoramento de qualidade de dados (Data Quality).

Resumo do Cargo

Buscamos um Product Owner (PO) Técnico altamente motivado para liderar a frente de consumo de dados e relatórios dentro da workstream de modernização. O PO será a ponte essencial entre as necessidades de negócio e a complexidade técnica da integração de dados em arquiteturas cloud-native . O foco principal é garantir que os relatórios sejam construídos com precisão e eficiência, utilizando dados provenientes de sistemas legados migrados e do Data Fabric global.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão do Produto (Relatórios e Dados):
  • Definir, priorizar e manter o backlog de recursos (funcionalidades e histórias de usuário) necessários para o consumo de dados do Data Fabric e a construção dos relatórios finais.
  • Atuar como stakeholder primário para validação de entregas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Especialista em Integração e API:
  • Profundo conhecimento no consumo de dados via API , definindo padrões de requisição e resposta para payloads complexos.
  • Conhecimento prático em GraphQL é mandatório, sendo responsável por desenhar as queries mais eficientes para extração e composição dos dados no Orquestrador de Relatórios.
  • Trabalhar ativamente com o time de Engenharia para definir os schemas de dados e a governança de APIs.
  • Qualidade e Migração de Dados:
  • Liderar a fase de análise de dados migrados de sistemas legados para a nuvem , garantindo a integridade, a qualidade e a equivalência das informações.
  • Definir e coordenar a execução de Testes de Equivalência (Equivalence Testing) para garantir que os relatórios construídos na nova arquitetura (Data Fabric) correspondam exatamente aos resultados do sistema legado.
  • Colaboração Técnica e Operacional:
  • Colaborar diretamente com os Data Stewards e times de Engenharia de Dados para entender a origem, o tratamento e a disponibilização dos dados no Data Fabric.
  • Liderar o discovery e o refinamento de requisitos complexos, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis e performáticas.

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.

Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !

Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).

Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.

Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.

Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction

We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

title: Analista de Operações Pleno

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. title: Blockchain Engineering Manager (Remote - LATAM)
description:
Blockchain Engineering Manager

Location: Americas, Remote

About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.

Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!

Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Blockchain Engineering Manager to lead, mentor, and grow a distributed team of software engineers. This role is responsible for driving execution, ensuring technical excellence, and fostering a high-performance culture that delivers reliable, scalable, and high-quality products aligned with Pointsville’s strategic goals.

What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Lead, coach, and mentor engineers across multiple technical domains.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Support career growth, performance management, and professional development.
  • Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and building a diverse, high-performing team.

Execution and Delivery

  • Oversee the end-to-end software development lifecycle, from planning and design to deployment and maintenance.
  • Partner with the CTO and Product Manager to translate product roadmaps into engineering execution plans.
  • Manage delivery timelines, resources, and technical dependencies to ensure on-time releases.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers, ensuring team productivity and alignment.

Performance and Improvement

  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices across code quality, smart contract security, and infrastructure reliability.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and performance in blockchain and microservice-based environments.
  • Drive the adoption of modern DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, automated testing).
  • Stay current with emerging blockchain technologies, protocols, and DeFi developments to guide innovation and continuous improvement.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of software development experience, including 6+ years in an engineering leadership or management role.
  • Familiarity with blockchains such as Ethereum and other blockchains preferred
  • Familiarity with DeFi trading a plus
  • Software engineering background in frontend and backend services development
  • An understanding of microservice architecture and cloud-based deployments
  • Experience in modern software development practices such as infrastructure as code, test automation, CI/CD and containerization
  • Proven success leading technical teams through the full product lifecycle in Agile or startup environments.
  • Experience with modern programming languages and frameworks (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or C#).
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to balance technical depth with people management and cross-functional alignment.

We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

description:

title: Legal Counsel
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Scope : Senior executive officer responsible for the overall management and legal representation of the company in Brazil, ensuring full compliance with applicable laws and regulations, alignment with group strategy, and sound governance, risk and control frameworks. Acts as the company’s legal representative alongside other three directors before public authorities, regulators, financial institutions and key partners.

Key responsibilities : • Corporate management: lead the implementation of the business plan in Brazil, follow HQ priorities and ensure operational and financial targets are met. • Legal representation: act as the company’s legal representative before the Central Bank of Brazil and other regulators, tax authorities, courts, financial institutions, partners and suppliers, signing contracts, powers of attorney and corporate documents. • Regulatory relationship: maintain a constructive and transparent relationship with Brazilian regulators and self-regulatory bodies, including responding to inspections, official inquiries and information requests. • Financial stewardship: approve budgets according to HQ instructions, monitor cash flow, capital and liquidity needs, and ensure timely and accurate financial according to the finance team and regulatory reporting. • People and culture: build and lead the local leadership team, promote an ethical culture, and ensure adherence to the company’s code of conduct and policies, acting in a horizontal relationship alongside officers responsible for AML/CFT, Internal Controls & Compliance, and Risk, Capital & Disclosure.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional experience, with solid background in financial services, payments, fintech and/or crypto, including prior experience in leadership or management roles;
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory landscape applicable to the business (Central Bank of Brazil, COAF and, where relevant, CVM and other authorities).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, Finance, Engineering or a related field; a MBA or similar is a plus.
  • Proven leadership, stakeholder-management and decision-making skills, with a hands-on, ownership mindset.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must be resident in Brazil.
  • No disqualifying factors as described below:

I — not to be barred by special law, nor convicted of bankruptcy crimes, tax evasion, malfeasance, active or passive bribery, extortion, embezzlement, crimes against the popular economy, public faith, property, or the National Financial System, nor sentenced to a penalty that prohibits, even temporarily, access to public office;

II — not to have been declared disqualified or suspended from serving in statutory or contractual bodies at institutions authorized to operate by the Central Bank of Brazil or at pension entities, insurance companies, capitalization companies, publicly held companies, or entities subject to the supervision of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Brazil (CVM);

III — not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;

IV — unblemished reputation;

V — knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;

VI — technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

Aqui, você terá contato com diversos projetos de mobilidade e infraestrutura de transportes, em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo e o desenvolvimento de cada profissional.

A confiança transporta o mundo, e para nós isso significa criar um ambiente onde todas as pessoas possam pertencer e crescer. Nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas à diversidade de talentos que movem a mobilidade do futuro.

title: InfraSecOps Manager (Foco em Gestão de Vulnerabilidades)
description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro

A Getnet é uma empresa global de tecnologia especializada em soluções de pagamento para o comércio. Fundada no Brasil e presente na América Latina e na Península Ibérica, apoiamos mais de 1,3 milhão de comerciantes com serviços completos — da maquininha ao e-commerce.

Fazemos parte da PagoNxt , a fintech global do Grupo Santander, e atuamos como um hub de adquirência com forte presença em Espanha, Portugal, Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai .

Nossa missão é clara: simplificar os pagamentos com inovação, segurança e escala , ajudando negócios de todos os tamanhos a crescer com agilidade.

Oferecemos uma plataforma unificada que integra hardware, software, prevenção à fraude, adquirência, conciliação e serviços financeiros — tudo em um só ecossistema, para que nossos clientes possam focar no crescimento do seu negócio.

Fazer parte da Getnet é se juntar a uma empresa que combina a inovação de uma fintech com a solidez de um banco global.

Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.

Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.

Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?

Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de InfraSecOps Manager (Foco em Gestão de Vulnerabilidades) para se juntar ao nosso time.

O que você vai fazer

O Gerente de InfraSecOps será responsável por liderar uma squad dedicada à gestão contínua de vulnerabilidades, fortalecendo a postura de segurança de toda a organização. Essa liderança garantirá que todo o ciclo de identificação, priorização, correção e validação de vulnerabilidades seja executado com eficiência, alinhado às melhores práticas de mercado e aos requisitos regulatórios de uma empresa altamente crítica (ex.: fintech, pagamentos, serviços financeiros).

Além disso, o gerente atuará na integração com times de infraestrutura, cloud, SRE, segurança, operações e desenvolvimento para assegurar que remediações sejam rápidas, coordenadas e rastreáveis.

Responsabilidades Principais:

1. Liderança & Governança

• Liderar a squad de InfraSecOps especializada em Vulnerability Management (VM);

• Definir processos, SLAs, KPIs e OKRs ligados ao ciclo de remediação;

• Ser o ponto focal corporativo para auditorias internas e externas relacionadas a vulnerabilidades;

• Conduzir comitês de risco, fóruns técnicos e reports executivos.

2. Gestão de Vulnerabilidades (Core da Função)

• Garantir execução periódica de scans em ativos on-premises, cloud, containers, aplicações e endpoints;

• Analisar criticidade, correlacionar riscos e priorizar remediações com base em CVSS, EPSS, contexto de negócio e exposição real;

• Criar e revisar dashboards unificados para visibilidade do risco tecnológico;

• Desenvolver playbooks de correção, comunicação e escalonamento;

• Monitorar e exigir cumprimento dos SLAs de correção por cada área responsável.

3. Integração com Times de Infra e Engenharia

Trabalhar junto com equipes de:

• Cloud e Kubernetes (workloads vulneráveis, imagens, containers);

• Infraestrutura (servidores, banco de dados, redes, sistemas legados);

• SRE/DevOps (pipelines, automação, IaC);

• Segurança (IAM, hardening, EDR, SIEM);

• facilitar a execução prática das correções, garantindo engajamento e responsabilidade clara (RACI).

4. Automação & Observabilidade

• Automatizar processos de varredura, priorização e relatórios utilizando APIs dos scanners;

• Integrar ferramentas de vulnerabilidade aos pipelines de CI/CD;

• Criar mecanismos de alerta e monitoramento contínuo do risco;

• Acompanhar a eficácia das correções e validar que remediações realmente fecharam o gap.

5. Conformidade & Auditoria

• Garantir aderência a normas como PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, SOC2, LGPD e requisitos internos;

• Preparar evidências e relatórios de conformidade para órgãos reguladores e auditorias;

• Mapear exceções e documentar riscos residuais de forma clara e executiva.

6. Processos & Melhores Práticas

• Estruturar metodologias e políticas de Vulnerability Management;

• Realizar post-mortems quando vulnerabilidades críticas forem encontradas em produção;

• Implementar a cultura de “Secure by Default” e “Shift Left” em toda a organização.

✅ O que buscamos em você

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência comprovada com gestão de vulnerabilidades em larga escala;
  • Ferramentas como Qualys;
  • Ambientes cloud (AWS/Azure);
  • Kubernetes e containers;
  • Sistemas Linux/Windows;
  • Infraestrutura corporativa e redes;
  • Experiência com IaC (Terraform/Ansible), pipelines CI/CD e automação;
  • Vivência com ambientes regulados (fintech, bancos, telecom, e-commerce etc.);
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Espanhol desejável.

Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate

The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Jira, Confluence

description:
About the Role

The Process Optimization Partner plays a key role in transforming the People Team’s operations through technology, automation, and intelligent systems. You’ll analyse workflows, identify inefficiencies, and design scalable solutions that enhance the employee and stakeholder experience. This role blends strategic problem-solving with hands-on implementation, leveraging AI tools, process automation, chatbot systems, and dynamic knowledge bases to optimize how the People Team operates.

  • Develop structured documentation practices to ensure consistency and ease of information retrieval.
  • Implement taxonomy and tagging systems that enable quick search and smart recommendations.
  • Define and track key metrics related to process efficiency, automation adoption, and employee experience.
  • Use data and feedback to prioritize initiatives and communicate impact to leadership.
  • Stay current on emerging HR technologies, AI trends, and automation best practices.

Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in HR operations, process improvement, or business automation.

  • Hands-on experience with automation platforms (Zapier, Boomi, etc.) and/or AI assistants or chatbot builders (e.g. ChatGPT Enterprise, etc.)
  • Familiarity with HRIS platforms (HiBob, Workday, or similar).
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to translate strategy into execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a collaborative and analytical mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Hubspot CRM.
  • Exposure to AI prompt engineering, knowledge management, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Passion for creating intuitive, efficient, and employee-friendly systems.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • The People Team operates with greater speed, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Employees and managers can easily find answers through AI chatbots and a robust knowledge base.
  • Manual, repetitive tasks are reduced or eliminated through automation.
  • Continuous improvement becomes a core capability of the People function.

title: Head of Customer Success Engineering
description:
About Optibus:

is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.

About the Role:

We are looking for a customer-focused technical leader to join our global team! Based in Sao Paolo, Brazil, the Head of Customer Success Engineering, LatAm will serve as the leader of a team of product specialists (Customer Success Engineers) providing technical guidance during the entire post-sales customer lifecycle.

As the Head of Customer Success Engineering, LatAm, you’ll lead a team of CSEs, working with them to prioritize and resolve complex issues, mentor the team, and collaborate with internal teams to drive product improvements, process efficiencies, and market growth. With your technical expertise and leadership, you’ll play a key role in elevating the customer experience in the region.

This is a role with a strong client-facing component. You’ll be expected to spend at least three days per week working from a local Optibus office (if available) or on-site with customers. Travel within LatAm is required (up to ~35%).

Technical Delivery

  • Lead a Customer Success Engineering team that delivers technical value to customers over the entire post-sales lifecycle, including onboardings / implementations.
  • Ensure that projects and deliverables are completed on-time and on-budget, balancing customer requests with SOW and team effort.
  • Work in collaboration with PMO to achieve desired high-quality, on-time deliverables that provide customers value
  • Monitor performance of teams and provide timely feedback and development assistance
  • Risk identification and management detecting early signs of at-risk projects, designing mitigation plans, and creating a process and path for escalation and resolution
  • Provide inputs on forecasting on a weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual basis
  • Drive the team to achieve their annual utilization targets

Process

  • Execute process improvements and the development of policies, procedures, methods, and tools in support of faster, more efficient technical delivery
  • Partner with the sales team, product management, and support to influence changes or highlight opportunities in products, tooling, and strategy through data-driven analysis of customer friction.

Reporting

  • Report on staffing, utilization, project health, and financial performance for all projects

People

  • Mentor and coach a team of high performing Customer Success Engineers
  • Responsible for team management, including hiring, training, performance management and engagement

Requirements :

  • Please submit your CV in English for consideration!
  • Proven experience : 10+ years in a customer-facing technical role (e.g., Implementation, Presales, Solutions Engineering, or Consulting) in SaaS or transportation tech. At least 5 years of experience managing teams.

  • Seasoned risk manager : Experience mentoring teams that manage a portfolio of time-sensitive projects simultaneously, demonstrating experience with developing and maintaining project schedules, risk management and mitigation, and mastery of change management
  • Communication : Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, Spanish, and Portuguese , with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.

Preferred requirements:

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
* OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH"

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

* SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

* O QUE PROCURAMOS: *

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.
  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.
  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.
  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.
  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).

Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);

Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.

Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.

I MPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Arquiteto de Software (React Native)
description:
Arquiteto de Software (React Native)

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Arquiteto de Software, você será responsável por garantir que boas práticas de arquitetura sejam adotadas pelos times de desenvolvimento nos projetos e por criar visões arquiteturais que traduzam necessidades de negócio. Atuará também na comunicação da solução de forma clara ao time técnico, tomando decisões que facilitem a gestão do ciclo de vida dos produtos tecnológicos e materializem os objetivos de negócio, sendo responsável por implementar e acompanhar métricas de qualidade nos projetos.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Garantir a adoção de boas práticas de arquitetura nos projetos;
  • Criar visões arquiteturais que comuniquem a solução de forma clara ao time de desenvolvimento;
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em decisões técnicas e estruturais;
  • Tomar decisões que facilitem a gestão do ciclo de vida dos produtos;
  • Implementar e acompanhar métricas de qualidade;
  • Apoiar e orientar times de desenvolvimento em decisões arquiteturais;
  • Assegurar que soluções respeitem restrições e atendam atributos de qualidade;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com times multidisciplinares para garantir excelência técnica e experiência do usuário.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Domínio em React Native (Hooks, Context API, TypeScript, Navigation, Animations, Performance Optimization);
  • Experiência sólida com integrações nativas Android (Java/Kotlin) e iOS (Swift/Objective-C) — criação e manutenção de bridges;
  • Experiência com arquiteturas móveis modernas (Clean Architecture, MVI/MVVM, Redux, Flux ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD mobile (GitHub Actions, Fastlane, AppCenter, etc.);
  • Vivência com integração contínua com BFFs / REST APIs;
  • Forte domínio de modularização, code splitting e monorepos (ex: NX);
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados mobile (Jest, Detox, E2E, Unit Tests);
  • Experiência em publicação e distribuição (Google Play, App Store, TestFlight, Firebase App Distribution);
  • Comunicação técnica clara e colaborativa com times multidisciplinares;
  • Capacidade de mentorar e influenciar decisões técnicas em múltiplos squads;
  • Perfil investigativo e hands-on, com habilidade para diagnosticar e resolver gargalos complexos;
  • Foco em excelência técnica, segurança e experiência do usuário.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com React Native New Architecture (Fabric, TurboModules);
  • Dominar conceitos de arquitetura escalável (DDD, Event-Driven, Hexagonal);
  • Tiver experiência com micro frontends mobile ou arquitetura plugin-based;
  • Possuir conhecimento em segurança mobile avançada (OWASP Mobile, App Attest, biometria, criptografia local);
  • Tiver experiência com análise de performance nativa (Systrace, Perfetto, Instruments).

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office
  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional)
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer
  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga prontos para te receber

Carreira e desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo

Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

  1. Inscrição
  2. Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.
  3. Bate-papo com People
  4. Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura.
  5. Entrevista técnica com liderança
  6. Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências.
  7. Feedback final
  8. Independente do resultado, você receberá um retorno e os próximos passos serão alinhados com transparência.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Title: DevOps Engineer

Duration: 12 months (ASAP Start)

Work Type: Hybrid (3 Days Onsite per Week)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil )

Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and efficient DevOps solutions in Azure. The ideal candidate will have deep hands-on experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) , CI/CD pipelines , and infrastructure automation , with a strong background in cloud architecture and system reliability.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align DevOps practices with business goals.
  • Support incident , problem , and change management processes.
  • Architect, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for retail applications.
  • Deploy and manage containerized workloads using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Kubernetes.
  • Manage and optimize Azure infrastructure , ensuring performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform , ARM templates , and scripting tools ( PowerShell , Bash , Python ).
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting with Azure Monitor , Grafana , and related tools.
  • Support day-to-day DevOps operations and contribute to environment stability.
  • Develop and maintain scripts for automation and system optimization.
  • Ensure digital security, perform vulnerability management, and participate in disaster recovery planning and testing .
  • Troubleshoot networking, infrastructure, and deployment issues.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in technology with a strong focus on DevOps and cloud engineering .
  • Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure , including virtual machines, AKS, networking, storage, load balancers, and security.
  • Strong understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Hands-on experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab).
  • Proficient in infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform, ARM templates, or similar tools.
  • Solid programming experience in one or more languages: C#, Java, or Python .
  • Strong SQL and database experience (MS SQL Server, SSIS, SSRS, SSAS).
  • Skilled in scripting ( PowerShell , Bash ) and automation frameworks.
  • Experience applying modern Service Delivery methods — Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and ITIL-based processes.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with proven ability to work across teams.
  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices , including IAM, firewalls, and network security groups.

Desired Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert — validating expertise in designing and implementing DevOps practices on Azure.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert — demonstrating advanced Azure solution design skills.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) — validating Kubernetes deployment and management proficiency
  • Experience with retail or wholesale trading systems is a plus.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
  • Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
  • Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
  • Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
